lots.guide_summary: All evidence is SOLD hammer prices at Gowans (AUD, no conversion): single Huon slabs typically make $35 to $65 hammer (median $50 to $60), with about 5% reaching $105 to $180 for presumably larger pieces. Two unsold lots in 13 months. No asking prices sought (no listed source covers timber).
lots.working: keep: lowest surviving same-item SOLD figure used is the series median $50 (single slabs since July 2026; the literal lowest hammers of $15 to $20 are evidently offcuts and not size-comparable, and the $60 Sep 2026 batch median is higher). $50 / 1.198 = $41.74, round down to $40. flip: realistic resale is re-offering at Gowans or Marketplace at about the same $50; less an assumed 15% vendor commission and $0 postage (pickup) = $42.50; / 2.396 = $17.74, round down to $15. Flipping is not worthwhile; only bid to keep for your own woodwork.
lots.confidence_reason: Species is from the catalogue title; colour and grain in the photo are consistent with Huon pine but not proof, and no size or thickness is given. Many matching SOLD results opened, but none size-matched.
lots.dropped_entries: Dropped the researcher's UNSOLD entry '23 lots listed July to Sep 2026 had sale_price 0': not true. The 14 zero-price Huon slab lots are all listed 2026-10-04, which is the current auction 366 (including this lot). Replaced it with the 2 genuine unsold lots from 2026-03-09. Dropped the macrocarpa category-guide entry from this lot (it belongs to the macrocarpa lot; kept only as a note that macrocarpa slabs make a median $25 to $30). Kept the $160 single (2025-11-17) but folded it into the top-tail entry. Researcher's '304 lots since July' count mixes single and multi-slab titles; my single-slab count is 226 with the same $50 median.

lots.condition: Rough sawn, unfinished, with live edge and some inclusions; no obvious large splits in the photo.
lots.question_for_gowans: What are the length, width and thickness of lot 1114, and is it confirmed Huon pine (any smell or provenance from the supplier)?

lots.guide_summary: All SOLD hammer prices at Gowans (AUD, no conversion). Large single macrocarpa slabs make $60 to $70 hammer (one photo-matched at $65 in Jul 2026), the separately catalogued 'pine' slabs top out at $80 to $90, and the typical small slab is $25. No unsold lots recorded and no asking prices sought. The scanner's $150 to $350 guess has no support.
lots.working: keep: lowest surviving same-item SOLD for a large single slab is $60 (Dec 2025; the photo-matched $65 gives the same answer). $60 / 1.198 = $50.08, round down to $50. The series median of $25 is for smaller pieces and is not used. flip: resale about $65 (best size-matched sale) less an assumed 15% vendor commission, $0 postage (pickup) = $55.25; / 2.396 = $23.06, round down to $20. Not a worthwhile flip.
lots.confidence_reason: Species from the catalogue title only; the colour is pinker than most macrocarpa at Gowans, which is unusual but plausible. One photo-matched SOLD comp plus several unsized ones, all opened.
lots.dropped_entries: None dropped; all researcher figures checked against the API and match (lot ids, prices, bid counts, dates). Relabelled the 'PINE' slabs and bench seats as category guides (as the researcher did) and added the series median entry so the typical price is visible.
